title: TreasuryAccount (internal capital account)
description: One internal capital account. INVARIANT: one account holds ONE asset - a multi-asset balance is several accounts, so every movement names the asset it moves (backend/api/internal/finance/treasury/treasury.go Account doc). `owner_kind` is a closed set because an unlisted owner kind would make internal capital unauditable. Balances are obtained from `Balances` (a map of account id -> exact signed decimal) and absence there means UNKNOWN, not zero: Move refuses to touch an account it cannot see rather than inventing a starting balance.

asset.description: The single asset this account holds. Kept as the Go symbol string because no asset_id producer exists yet; asset_id is listed alongside for the migration.
